description: Implementation of the TaxRate DAO, providing methods to query TaxRate entities based on store, code, country, zone, and other criteria within the SalesManager e-commerce system.

classes.name: TaxRateDaoImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of TaxRateDao for accessing TaxRate data, extending generic DAO and adding store-specific query methods.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRates associated with a specific store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of TaxRates associated with a specific store, filtered by language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a TaxRate by its unique code within a specific store.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a TaxRate by its ID.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Lists TaxRates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.
